correctness.rationale: The state is normalized for n>=4. The published complex symmetric-product lemma justifies restricting all optimal product vectors to common single-qubit factors. Exact Dicke overlaps force n-2 azimuthal phases; logistic parametrization yields the exact hyperbolic objective. The ratio tanh(a t)/tanh(t) is strictly decreasing for a>1, giving one centered optimum at n=4,5 and exactly two noncentral maxima for all n>=6. Exact n=6 substitution yields 2/9. Uniform analytic upper/lower estimates squeeze the all-n maximum to 1/(2e). The reproduced direct-tensor and finite-grid tests corroborate, but are not the proof.

value.rationale: The complementary one-/n-minus-one-excitation superposition is a canonical maximally mixed-single-qubit state identified in the literature, so exact geometric entanglement and closest-product geometry are motivated invariants rather than arbitrary numerical slices. The theorem classifies a whole dimension-indexed family, finds a sharp change in the optimizer count at n=6, gives a clean exact n=6 value and a nontrivial high-dimensional constant; it is beyond a mere numerical recomputation or restatement of the general reduction.
